headline: Folarin Balogun's ban is lifted by FIFA, allowing U.S. striker to play Belgium
context: FIFA's Disciplinary Committee said it would suspend Balogun's one-game red card ban for a probationary period of one year. The Royal Belgian Football Federation said it was "astonished."

sources.name: NPR
